name: Northern Continent
description: Continent. The heart of the known world: fog-bound nations of gas lamps, railways, newspapers, and strict class lines, all built atop older epochs' buried secrets. Most campaigns begin here.

name: Loen Kingdom
description: Nation — constitutional monarchy. Victorian superpower of industry, banking, and colonial trade.

name: Backlund
description: Capital city. The sprawl capital: a million souls divided into West Borough aristocracy, factory districts choking on coal smoke, docklands of sailors and smugglers, and ministries where the real empire gets administered.

name: Pritz Harbor
description: Harbor / Naval base. Loen Kingdom's largest military and commercial port at the mouth of the Tasuo River, serving as the primary naval gateway to the Sonia Sea.

name: Tingen City
description: A mid-sized city in the Loen Kingdom, known as the 'City of Universities.' It is where the protagonist's journey begins and is home to a branch of the Nighthawks.

name: Enmat Harbor
description: Harbor town. A bustling coastal port town in eastern Loen, connecting domestic passenger liners and merchant vessels across the channel.

name: Conis City
description: Industrial city. An inland manufacturing and railway center in southern Loen, known for coal processing, machinery workshops, and dense worker housing.

name: Desi Bay
description: Coastal bay / Resort region. A scenic southern coastal bay and resort district in Desi County, favored by nobles and vacationers for warm beaches and mild waters.

name: Intis Republic
description: Nation — republic. France-analogue republic of salons, duels, and guillotined kings. Intis leads in art, cuisine, and espionage; its eternal rivalry with Loen plays out in trade wars and embassy intrigues rather than open battle.

name: Trier
description: Capital city. City of light: boulevards, opera houses, and a bohemian quarter where poets starve beautifully.

name: Cordu Village
description: A small, isolated village in the mountains of Intis, where the protagonist of *Circle of Inevitability* grew up. It is the site of mysterious supernatural events.

name: Feysac Empire
description: A continental power known for its military strength and deep religious traditions, often at odds with the Loen Kingdom.

name: Feynapotter Kingdom
description: Nation — kingdom. Rural kingdom of farms, forests, and old faith, closely tied to the Earth Mother church. Visitors find muddy roads, hearty food, and superstitions that turn out to be entirely accurate precautions.

name: Feynapotter City
description: Capital city. The sunlit capital of Feynapotter, ringed by fertile farmlands and crowned by the grand cathedral of the Church of the Earth Mother.

name: Lenburg
description: Nation — scholastic republic. A peaceful buffer nation dedicated to scholarship, home to the global headquarters of the Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom.

name: Midseashore
description: Region — coastal territory. A strategic coastal province and sea corridor connecting Loen and neighboring kingdoms along the central gulf coast.

name: Southern Continent
description: Continent. Land of jungles, savannas, and ancient ruins now carved into colonial holdings. Export: gold, exotic goods, and Beyonder materials harvested from creatures no textbook names.

name: Balam Empire
description: Empire — fragmented realm. An ancient empire spanning the Southern Continent, rich in Death pathway heritage and now partitioned under colonial exploitation.

name: West Balam
description: Region — tropical frontier. The western territory of Balam, filled with dense rainforests, mineral reserves, and bitter colonial skirmishes between Intis and Feysac.

name: East Balam
description: Region — colonial territory. The eastern territory of Balam dominated by Loen colonial governance, marked by plantation docks and rising native resistance movements.

name: Highlands Kingdom
description: Nation — sovereign kingdom. A resilient sovereign highland state that resisted colonial subjugation through treacherous mountain passes and fierce martial traditions.

name: Paz Valley
description: Region — secluded valley. A protected lush river valley in the Southern Continent preserving ancient indigenous customs, herbs, and forgotten deities.

name: Forsaken Land of the Gods
description: Forbidden region. A continent abandoned by the gods after an ancient catastrophe: perpetual night, mutated beasts, and scattered pockets of humanity fighting for light and food.

name: City of Silver
description: Fortified city. An ancient sanctuary of giant-descendants enduring perpetual darkness, fighting monstrous abominations with lightning and devotion.

name: Moon City
description: Isolated settlement. A severely mutated settlement clinging to survival in the dark wasteland, revering the Crimson Moon while resisting complete madness.

name: Afternoon Town
description: Ruined town. A desolate ruined town where daylight forever hangs frozen in perpetual dusk, filled with looping shadows and terrifying remnant spirits.

name: Giant King's Court
description: Mythical landmark / Divine palace. The monumental mountain palace of the Second Epoch Giant King Aurmir, towering in petrified majesty at the eastern edge of the darkness.

name: Rorsted Archipelago
description: Island chain. Scattered islands between continents: pirate havens, colonial ports, and free towns where any cargo moves for the right price. The Lord of Storms' Mandated Punishers raid often and rule never quite.

name: City of Generosity, Bayam
description: A port city in the Rorsted Archipelago known for its diverse population, supernatural activity, and the influence of the Sea God.

name: Gargas Archipelago
description: Island chain. A cluster of eastern islands famous for deep-sea whaling, monster hunting, and native folk customs outside central church governance.

name: Nas
description: Harbor city. The bustling principal harbor of the Gargas Archipelago, filled with whalers, monster butchers, and dealers in maritime occult curios.

name: Oravi Island
description: Island. A key mid-ocean provisioning stop for merchant and pirate vessels alike, known for lively taverns and black-market deals.

name: Damir Harbor
description: Harbor town. A scenic island harbor town renowned for cured hams, safe anchorage, and passenger steamers running the standard ocean line.

name: Bansy Harbor
description: Harbor town. An eerie historic port steeped in ancient sacrificial customs and lingering ties to the bloodline of the Red Angel Medici.

name: Toskar
description: Harbor town. A tranquil southern island harbor serving as a vital coal refueling and freshwater restocking station for long-voyage liners.

name: Sonia Sea
description: Ocean. The vast ocean dividing the Northern and Southern Continents, teeming with pirate armadas, sea beasts, and mysterious islands.

name: Fog Sea
description: Ocean. An endless western ocean shrouded in thick unnatural fog, hosting colonial outposts, isolated primitive islands, and routes toward sealed lands.

name: Berserk Sea
description: Ocean. A chaotic expanse of perpetual lightning storms, violent maelstroms, and warped magnetic fields that sever direct sea passage.
